node.label: Alan Taylor
node.date_label: American Colonies (2001) · The Divided Ground (2006) · The Civil War of1812 (2010)
node.description: Historian of early North America whose continental approach unsettles self-contained national narratives. Taylor’s interview on American Civil Wars connects conflicts in the United States,Mexico and Canada through intervention,union and political economy. His work also treats British and American sovereignty as incomplete projects rather than inevitable outcomes of a single national revolution.
